```{r calculate KFRE 5 year Major et al UK calibrated KFRE}

#Major RW, Shepherd D, Medcalf JF, Xu G, Gray LJ, Brunskill NJ. The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study. PLOS Medicine. 2019;16(11):e1002955.

 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old - egfrcr09  


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09<-function(age, female, acr2, egfrcr09) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09 is old CKDepi equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 

 
  # KFRE equation using new eGFRcrcys No Race 2012 equation 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace<-function(age, female, acr2, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcrcys12 is 2012 race free eGFRcrcys equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
  # KFRE equation using eGFRcys 2012 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcys_2012<-function(age, female, acr2, eGFRcys_2012) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcys09 is 2009 CKD-EPI eGFR cystatin C equation (includes race)
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcys_2012))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcys_2012/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
           
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old where all race coded as non-black - egfrcr09_race_allnonblack 


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack<-function(age, female, acr2, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack is old CKDepi equation with all race coded as nonblack
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1 <- (1-0.957^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 


```

```{r calculate KFRE using 2 year Major et al. UK recalibrated equations}

  } 

 
  # KFRE equation using new eGFRcrcys No Race 2012 equation

     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcrcys12 is 2012 race free eGFRcrcys equation
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1_2yr <- (1-0.9878^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_1_2yr

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
  # KFRE equation using eGFRcys 2012 
  
 KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_2yr<-function(age, female, acr2, eGFRcys_2012) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcys09 is 2009 CKD-EPI eGFR cystatin C equation (includes race)
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(eGFRcys_2012))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    

      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1_2yr <- (1-0.9878^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(eGFRcys_2012/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
           
      # Output
      KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_1_2yr

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
 } 
 
 # KFRE equation using egfr CKDepi old where all race coded as non-black - egfrcr09_race_allnonblack 


#create function to calculate KFRE

 KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_2yr<-function(age, female, acr2, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack) {
    
     # age in years, sex ==0 is Female | sex==1 is male, acr2 is urineACR mg/mmol, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack is old CKDepi equation with all race coded as nonblack
      if (!is.null(age) & !is.null(female) & !is.null(acr2) & !is.null(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))
  {
    age <- as.numeric(age)
    
  

      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1_2yr <- (1-0.9878^exp((-0.2201*(age/10-7.036))+(0.2467*(female-0.5642))-(0.5567*(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack/5-7.222))+(0.451*(log(acr2/0.113)-5.137))))
      
          
      # Output
      KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_1_2yr

    }  else
      stop ("Different number of observations between variables")
  } 

 
  linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>%
        mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_2yr(age, female, acr2, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_2yr(age, female, acr2, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_2yr(age, female, acr2, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))
```

```{r Baseline characteristics tables}


scream_CKD = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(rrt = ifelse(is.na(rrt),0,rrt)) %>% 
  mutate(cardio_mm = ifelse(card_met_mmcount_cat==0|card_met_mmcount_cat==1, 0, 1))

card_mm_count <- linear_predictor %>% 
  group_by(cardio_mm==0) %>% 
  summarise(total = n())

  scream_CKD$age <- as.numeric(as.character(scream_CKD$age))

# Define the summary statistics for each variable
summaries <- list(
  Age = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(age),
    "Max" = ~ max(age),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(age)
  ),
  eGFR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Max" = ~ max(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)
  ),
  eGFRCys = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Max" = ~ max(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(eGFRcys_2012)
  ),
  "Cystatin C" = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(cysc_value),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(cysc_value),
    "Max" = ~ max(cysc_value),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(cysc_value)
  ),
  ACR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(acr2),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(acr2),
    "Median (IQR) zero excluded" = ~ median_iqr(acr2[acr2 != 0]),
    "Max" = ~ max(acr2),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(acr2)
  ),
  Sex = list(
    "Male" = ~ n_perc0(female == 1),
    "Female" = ~ n_perc0(female == 0)
  ),
  "Follow-up time (months)" = list(
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(futime_months),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(futime_months)
  ),
  Death = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(death == 1)
  ),
  KRT = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(rrt == 1)
  ),
   "LTC count" = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(mmcount_nockd)
))

scream_CKD %>% 
  summary_table(summaries)

# Create the baseline characteristics table
BL_wholecohort <- scream_CKD %>% 
  summary_table((summaries))
  
BL_mm <- scream_CKD %>%
  group_by(mmcount_nockd >= 2) %>%
  summary_table(summaries)

BL_card_met_mm <- scream_CKD %>% 
  group_by(cardio_mm) %>%
  summary_table(summaries)

#check event and death numbers per mm count group
scream_CKD %>% 
  group_by(mmcount_nockd_cat) %>% 
  summarise(rrt_events = sum(rrt, na.rm = TRUE))

scream_CKD %>% 
  group_by(mmcount_nockd_cat) %>% 
  summarise(death = sum(death, na.rm = TRUE))

scream_CKD <- scream_CKD %>% 
  mutate(death_norrt = ifelse(rrt==0&death==1,1,0))

outcomes <- scream_CKD %>% 
  select(lopnr, rrt, rrt_date_c, death, dodsdat, death_norrt)
scream_CKD %>% 
  group_by(mmcount_nockd_cat) %>% 
  summarise(death_norrt = sum(death_norrt, na.rm = TRUE))

Outcome_events_2yrs = sum(linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs)
Outcome_events_5yrs = sum(linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs)

    sum_death_2yrs = sum(death_2yrs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum_death_5yrs = sum(death_5yrs, na.rm=TRUE),
    Total = n()
  ) %>% 
   mutate(Perc_outcome_2yrs = (sum_outcome_2yrs / Total) * 100,
```

```{r calibration curve KFRE-Cr, KFRE-Cys, KFRE-CrCys}
pdf(file="calibration curves whole cohort_rug_SCREAM.pdf", width=15, height=6)
par(mfrow=c(2,3))

##KFRECr
score.cr2 <- Score(list(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr), 
                      Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs)~ 1,
                      data=linear_predictor, plots="cal",
                      metrics=NULL, 
                      cens.model="local", conf.int=TRUE, times=24)
```

```{r histograms KFRE risk distribution nomm 5yrs}
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold")) + 
  ggtitle("KFRE risk distribution using eGFR cystatin:\n SCREAM No Multimorbidity cohort")

print(eGFRcys_distribution_nomm)

eGFRcrcys_distribution_nomm <- ggplot(no_mm, aes(x = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#2D708EFF", bins = 100) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy=1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  xlab("Predicted risk") +
  ylab("") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 5000), breaks = seq(0, 5000, by = 1000)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold")) + 
  ggtitle("KFRE risk distribution using eGFR creatinine-cystatin:\n SCREAM No Multimorbidity cohort")

print(eGFRcrcys_distribution_nomm)
```

```{r  O/E ratios egfrcr}
## O/E ratio

#whole cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5 <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = linear_predictor), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5 <- (1 - obj5$surv)/mean(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2 <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = linear_predictor), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2 <- (1 - obj2$surv)/mean(linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)

#mm cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5_mm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = mm), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5_mm <- (1 - obj5_mm$surv)/mean(mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2_mm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = mm), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2_mm <- (1 - obj2_mm$surv)/mean(mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)

#no_mm cohort
# observed risk of rrt at 5 years
obj5_nomm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ 1, data = no_mm), times = 60, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_5_nomm <- (1 - obj5_nomm$surv)/mean(no_mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1) 

# observed risk of rrt at 2 years
obj2_nomm <- summary(survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data = no_mm), times = 24, extend = TRUE)
# O/E ratio 
OE_2_nomm <- (1 - obj2_nomm$surv)/mean(no_mm$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr)


# Confidence intervals using method proposed in Debray et al. (2017)
alpha <- 0.05
OE_summary_cr <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("OE", "Lower .95", "Upper .95"),
  whole_cohort_5 = c(OE_5, exp(log(OE_5 - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5$std.err / (1-obj5$surv))), exp(log(OE_5 + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5$std.err / (1-obj5$surv)))),
  whole_cohort_2 = c(OE_2, exp(log(OE_2 - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2$std.err / (1-obj2$surv))),exp(log(OE_2 + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2$std.err / (1-obj2$surv)))),
  mm_5 = c(OE_5_mm, exp(log(OE_5_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_mm$surv)))),
  mm_2 = c(OE_2_mm, exp(log(OE_2_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_mm$surv)))),
  nomm_5 = c(OE_5_nomm, exp(log(OE_5_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_nomm$std.err / (1-obj5_nomm$surv)))),
  nomm_2 = c(OE_2_nomm, exp(log(OE_2_nomm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))), exp(log(OE_2_nomm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_nomm$std.err / (1-obj2_nomm$surv))))
  )


kable(OE_summary_cr) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r  O/E ratios egfrcys - card_met_mm}
OE_2_card_met_mm <- (1 - obj2_card_met_mm$surv)/mean(card_met_mm$KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_2yr)



# Confidence intervals using method proposed in Debray et al. (2017)
alpha <- 0.05
OE_summary_cys_card_met_mm <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("OE", "Lower .95", "Upper .95"),
  card_met_mm_5 = c(OE_5_card_met_mm, exp(log(OE_5_card_met_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_card_met_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_card_met_mm$surv))), exp(log(OE_5_card_met_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj5_card_met_mm$std.err / (1-obj5_card_met_mm$surv)))),
  card_met_mm_2 = c(OE_2_card_met_mm, exp(log(OE_2_card_met_mm - qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_card_met_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_card_met_mm$surv))),exp(log(OE_2_card_met_mm + qnorm(1 - alpha / 2) * obj2_card_met_mm$std.err / (1-obj2_card_met_mm$surv))))
  )


kable(OE_summary_cys_card_met_mm) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r calibration intercept & slope impute acr 0.1 for 0 & recalculate PI}
####IMPUTE uACR 0.1 when 0 values are present

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(acr3 = (if_else(acr2==0, 0.1, acr2))) %>% 
mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3 = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace(age, female, acr3, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_acr3 = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012(age, female, acr3, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3 = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack(age, female, acr3, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)) %>% 
mutate(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1_acr3_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace_2yr(age, female, acr3, eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))%>%
    mutate(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121_acr3_2yr = KFRE_eGFRcys_2012_2yr(age, female, acr3, eGFRcys_2012)) %>%
    mutate(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr = KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack_2yr(age, female, acr3, egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))

###################################################################

#non-North American KFRE 
coefficients<-c(-0.2201, 0.2467, 0.451, -0.5567)
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9832
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9878
#Original KFRE baseline survival intercept_value_2yrs <- 0.9365
#Major recalibrated baseline survival 
intercept_value_5yrs <- 0.9570

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_acr3 = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr3) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_acr3 = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr3) + 
  (coefficients[4] * egfrcr09_race_allnonblack))

PI_2_acr3 <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_acr3

PI_5_acr3 <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_acr3

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(log_PI_2yrs_acr3 = log(PI_2yrs_acr3))
###################################################################

cox_model_2yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)

cox_model_5yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs_acr3)

# Get the linear predictor from the Cox model
linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred_acr3 <- as.numeric(predict(cox_model_2yrs_acr3, type = "lp"))

# Calculate predicted survival probabilities using the formula: S(t) = exp(-H0(t)^exp(cox_linear_pred))
linear_predictor$predicted_survival_acr3 <- exp(-survfit(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)$surv * exp(linear_predictor$cox_linear_pred_acr3))



cox_model_2yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ PI_2yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_2yrs_acr3)

cox_model_5yrs_acr3 = coxph(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_5yrs) ~ PI_5yrs_acr3, data = linear_predictor)

summary(cox_model_5yrs_acr3)
```

```{r calibration intercept and slope - creatinine 2 years}
####whole cohort - creatinine
# log cumulative hazard
linear_predictor$cumhaz_acr3 <- log(-log(1-linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_acr3_2yr))
# Pseudo-observations
km.whole_2 <- survfit(Surv(fu_2, outcome_2yrs) ~ 1, data=linear_predictor)
linear_predictor$yhat2 <- 1 - pseudo(km.whole_2, times=24, type="surv")
summary(linear_predictor$yhat2)

pseudos <- data.frame(linear_predictor$Calibration$plotframe)

# model for calibration intercept
whole_cal_int_2 <- geese(
  yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3), 
  data = linear_predictor, 
  id = lopnr, 
  scale.fix = TRUE, 
  family = gaussian, 
  mean.link = "cloglog",
  corstr = "independence", 
  jack = TRUE)

# model for calibration slope
whole_cal_slope_2 <- geese(yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3) + cumhaz_acr3, data = linear_predictor, id=lopnr, scale.fix = TRUE, 
                      family = gaussian, mean.link = "cloglog",
                      corstr = "independence", jack = TRUE)

res_cal_2 <- rbind(
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration intercept
  "Intercept" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_int_2)$mean,
    c(
      "estimate" = estimate,
      `2.5 %` = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se,
      `97.5 %` = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se
    )
  ),
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration slope
  "Slope" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_slope_2)$mean["cumhaz_acr3", ],
    c(
      "estimate" = 1 + estimate,
      `2.5 %` = 1 + (estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se),
      `97.5 %` = 1 + (estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se)
    )
  )
)

kable(res_cal_2) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r calibration intercept & slope - KFREcys whole cohort 2 years}
  yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3_cys), 
```
```{r calibration intercept and slope - creatinine 2 years mm4}
  data = mm4_acr3, 
  id = lopnr, 
  scale.fix = TRUE, 
  family = gaussian, 
  mean.link = "cloglog",
  corstr = "independence", 
  jack = TRUE)

# model for calibration slope
```
```{r calibration intercept & slope - KFREcys mm4 cohort 2 years}
whole_cal_slope_2_cys <- geese(yhat2 ~ offset(cumhaz_acr3_cys) + cumhaz_acr3_cys, data = mm4_acr3, id=lopnr, scale.fix = TRUE, 
                      family = gaussian, mean.link = "cloglog",
                      corstr = "independence", jack = TRUE)

res_cal_2_cys <- rbind(
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration intercept
  "Intercept" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_int_2_cys)$mean,
    c(
      "estimate" = estimate,
      `2.5 %` = estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se,
      `97.5 %` = estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se
    )
  ),
  # Value, confidence interval and test for calibration slope
  "Slope" = with(
    summary(whole_cal_slope_2_cys)$mean["cumhaz_acr3_cys", ],
    c(
      "estimate" = 1 + estimate,
      `2.5 %` = 1 + (estimate - qnorm(0.975) * san.se),
      `97.5 %` = 1 + (estimate + qnorm(0.975) * san.se)
    )
  )
)

kable(res_cal_2_cys) |>
  kable_styling("striped", position = "center")
```

```{r measures by KFRE risk groups}
linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(
    riskgrp = ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 <0.03, 0, 
              ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 >= 0.03 & KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 < 0.05, 1,
              ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 >= 0.05 & KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 < 0.15, 2,
              ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 >= 0.15 & KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 < 0.25, 3,
              ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 >= 0.25 & KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 < 0.5, 4,
              ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1 >= 0.5, 5, NA)))))))


summaries <- list(
  Age = list(
      "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(age)
  ),
  eGFR = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(egfrcr09_race_allnonblack)
  ),
  eGFRCys = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(eGFRcys_2012),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(eGFRcys_2012)
  ),
  ACR = list(
    "Min" = ~ min(acr2),
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(acr2),
    "Max" = ~ max(acr2),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(acr2)
  ),
  Sex = list(
    "Male" = ~ n_perc0(female == 1),
    "Female" = ~ n_perc0(female == 0)
  ),
   LTCcount = list(
    "Median (IQR)" = ~ median_iqr(mmcount_nockd[!is.na(mmcount_nockd)]),
    "Mean (SD)" = ~ mean_sd(mmcount_nockd[!is.na(mmcount_nockd)])),
  LTCnperc = list(
    "MM" = ~ n_perc0((mmcount_nockd >= 2))
  ),
   Death = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(death == 1)
  ),
  Death_2yrs =list(
    "Yes"= ~ n_perc0(death_2yrs == 1)
  ),
    Death_5yrs =list(
    "Yes"= ~ n_perc0(death_5yrs == 1)
  ),
  "ESKD within 2 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_2yrs ==0)
  ),
  "ESKD within 5 years" = list(
    "Yes" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_5yrs ==1),
    "No" = ~ n_perc0(outcome_5yrs ==0)
  )
)

# Create the baseline characteristics table
BL_riskgrp <- linear_predictor %>% 
  group_by(riskgrp) %>% 
  summary_table((summaries))
```

```{r precision, recall, PPV, AUPROC - whole cohort 2 years}

##library(Metrics)
##library(caret)

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% mutate(KFRE_GT5_2yr = ifelse(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr>= 0.05, 1, 0),
                                                  outcome_2yrs = factor(outcome_2yrs, levels = c(0, 1)),
                                                  KFRE_GT5_2yr = factor(KFRE_GT5_2yr, levels = c(0, 1)))

# Predicted and actual labels
predicted <- linear_predictor$KFRE_GT5_2yr
actual <- linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs

KFRE_2yrs_GT5_metrics <- confusionMatrix(predicted, actual,
                mode = "everything",
                positive="1")

KFRE_2yrs_GT5_metrics


pred_probs <- linear_predictor$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1_2yr
labels <- linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs

auprc_boot <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = d$pred[d$label == 1],
                 scores.class1 = d$pred[d$label == 0],
                 curve = FALSE)
  return(pr$auc.integral)
}

# Scores for positive and negative classes
pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = pred_probs[labels == 1],
               scores.class1 = pred_probs[labels == 0],
               curve = TRUE)

# Show AUPRC
print(pr$auc.integral)

df <- data.frame(pred = pred_probs, label = labels)

# Run bootstrap (e.g., 1000 replicates)
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = auprc_boot, R = 1000)

# 95% CI
boot.ci(boot_results, type = "perc")
```

```{r precision, recall, PPV, AUPROC - whole cohort 5 years}
auprc_boot <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = d$pred[d$label == 1],
                 scores.class1 = d$pred[d$label == 0],
                 curve = FALSE)
  return(pr$auc.integral)
}
```

```{r Discrimination measures}
##Harrel's c-index
#Original KFRE

C_index_2yrs <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]

##Linear predictor in different KFRE equations
#Cystatin
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_cys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012 )) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_cys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012))

PI_2_cys <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_cys

PI_5_cys <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_cys

#Combined CrCys
linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>% 
  mutate(PI_2yrs_crcys = intercept_value_2yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace)) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_crcys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace))

PI_2_crcys <- linear_predictor$PI_2yrs_crcys

PI_5_crcys <- linear_predictor$PI_5yrs_crcys

##KFRE using eGFR cystatin equation
C_index_2yrs_cys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2_cys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs_cys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5_cys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]

##KFRE using eGFR combined creatinine cystatin equation
C_index_2yrs_crcys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_2_crcys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_2yrs))[1]

C_index_5yrs_crcys <- rcorr.cens(-1*PI_5_crcys, Surv(linear_predictor$futime_months_rounded, linear_predictor$outcome_5yrs))[1]



# Create a data frame with c-index values
c_index_table <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Creatinine", "Creatinine", "Cystatin", "Cystatin", "Creatinine-Cystatin", "Creatinine-Cystatin"),
  Time = c("2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years", "2 years", "5 years"),
  C_Index = c(C_index_2yrs, C_index_5yrs, C_index_2yrs_cys, C_index_5yrs_cys, C_index_2yrs_crcys, C_index_5yrs_crcys)
)

# Reshape the data from long to wide format
c_index_table_wide <- c_index_table %>% 
  spread(key = Time, value = C_Index)

# Print the reshaped table
print(c_index_table_wide)
```

```{r c-index without 95% CIs}
# Bootstrap c-index to get confidence interval:
# Create truncated dataset (2 years cut off)

linear_predictor = linear_predictor %>%
mutate(time = (futime_months/12))
two.trunc <- linear_predictor
two.trunc$outcome <- ifelse(two.trunc$time>2, 0, two.trunc$outcome) 
two.trunc$time <- ifelse(two.trunc$time>2, 2.001, two.trunc$time)

# c index
rcorr.cens(-1*two.trunc$PI_2yrs, Surv(two.trunc$time, two.trunc$outcome))[1]
# c index – Cys 2yrs
rcorr.cens(-1*two.trunc$PI_2yrs_cys, Surv(two.trunc$time, two.trunc$outcome))[1]
# c index – CrCys 2yrs
rcorr.cens(-1*two.trunc$PI_2yrs_crcys, Surv(two.trunc$time, two.trunc$outcome))[1]

################################################
```

```{r c-index 95% CI cardio metabolic multimorbidity group}
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) + 
  (coefficients[3] * acr2) + 
  (coefficients[4] * eGFRcys_2012 )) %>% 
  mutate(PI_5yrs_cys = intercept_value_5yrs + 
  (coefficients[1] * age) + 
  (coefficients[2] * female) +
```

```{r c-index 95% CI NO cardio metabolic multimorbidity group}
two.trunc.no_card_met_mm <- no_card_met_mm
two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$outcome <- ifelse(two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$time>2, 0, two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$outcome) 
two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$time <- ifelse(two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$time>2, 2.001, two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$time)

rcorr.cens(-1*two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$PI_2yrs, Surv(two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$time, two.trunc.no_card_met_mm$outcome))[1]

# Bootstrap c-index to get confidence interval – Cr 2yrs

C_boot <- function(data, i) {
  val <- data[i,] # select sample with boot
  rcorr.cens(-1*val$PI_2yrs, Surv(val$time, val$outcome))[1]
}
set.seed(1234)
twoboot.no_card_met_mm <- boot(two.trunc.no_card_met_mm, C_boot, R=1000)
```

```{r KM curves for risk groups}



##Original KFRE

cutoffs <- c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.50, Inf)

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(risk_group_KFRE = cut(KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1, breaks = cutoffs, 
                                  include.lowest = TRUE,
                                  labels = c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%")))

fit_KFRE <- survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome) ~ risk_group_KFRE, data = linear_predictor)

# Create survival curve plot
KFRE_orig <- ggsurvplot(fit_KFRE)

## KFRE cys

cutoffs <- c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.50, Inf)

linear_predictor <- linear_predictor %>%
  mutate(risk_group_KFRE_cys = cut(KFRE_eGFRcys_20121, breaks = cutoffs, 
                                  include.lowest = TRUE,
                                  labels = c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%")))

fit_KFRE_cys <- survfit(Surv(futime_months_rounded, outcome_2yrs) ~ risk_group_KFRE_cys, data = linear_predictor)

# Create survival curve plot
KFRE_cys <- ggsurvplot(fit_KFRE_cys)

  mutate(risk_group_KFRE_crcys = cut(KFRE_eGFRcrcys_new_NoRace1, breaks = cutoffs,

                                  labels = c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%")))
```

```{r Multimorbidity distribution and clusters}
###Multimorbidity LTC distribution
long_term_conditions <- linear_predictor$mmcount_nockd

#Histogram
histogram_LTC <- ggplot(data.frame(long_term_conditions), aes(x = long_term_conditions)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#481567FF", color = 'grey') +
  labs(title = 'Distribution of Long-Term Condition counts in SCREAM Cohort', 
       x = 'Number of Long-Term Conditions', 
       y = 'Number of Individuals') +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 11, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 7000, by = 1000)) +
  stat_bin(binwidth = 1, geom = "text", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.5, color = "black") +
  theme_minimal()




### Multimorbidity clusters
cardiomm_count = sum(linear_predictor$cardio_mm==1)
complexLTC1_count = sum(linear_predictor$complexLTC1==1)
mixedLTC1_count = sum(linear_predictor$mixedLTC1==1)
painLTC1_count = sum(linear_predictor$painLTC1==1)
liverLTC_count = sum(linear_predictor$liverLTC==1)

mm_clusters <- data.frame(
  cluster = c('Cardiometabolic', 'Complex', 'Mixed', 'Pain', 'Liver'),
  count = c(cardiomm_count, complexLTC1_count, mixedLTC1_count, painLTC1_count, liverLTC_count)
)

#Bar plot
ggplot(mm_clusters, aes(x = cluster, y = count, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity') +
  labs(title = 'Distribution of Multimorbidity Clusters in SCREAM cohort', x = 'Multimorbidity Cluster', y = 'Number of Individuals') +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d()
```

#Competing risk 

```{r considering competing risk of mortality}

#dataset for competing risk analysis
compr <- readRDS("~/R working directory/SCREAM/venn_scream.rds")



# Change event indicator to three variables - ESKD=1, Death=2
compr$event <- ifelse(compr$death==1, 2, 0)
compr$event <- ifelse(compr$outcome==1, 1, compr$event)
compr = compr %>% 
  mutate(time = (futime_months/12))

# Risk group of pre-proposed risks
compr$riskgrp <- cut(compr$KFRE_egfrcr09_race_allnonblack1, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.03, 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.5, Inf), 
                     labels=c("<3%", "3-<5%", "5-<15%", "15-<25%", "25-<50%", ">=50%"),
                     right = FALSE)

compr_mm <- subset(compr, compr$mmcount_nockd >1)
compr_nomm <- subset(compr, compr$mmcount_nockd<=1)
```

```{r}
# Cumulative incidence curves
# AJ for mm & nomm no risk group
aj_mm <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ 1, data = compr_mm)
aj_nomm <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~ 1, data = compr_nomm)

# Plot risk of both causes
pdf(file="compr_SCREAM.pdf", width=15, height=6)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))

CR_mm_5 <- plot(aj_mm, cause="stacked", confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
                ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure or death", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0, 5), 
                legend.title="Competing risk",
                legend.legend=c("Kidney failure", "Death"), 
                legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.9, lwd=2)
title("Cumulative Incidence curve:\nMultimorbidity cohort")


CR_nomm_5 <- plot(aj_nomm, cause="stacked", confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
                  ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure or death", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0, 5), 
                  legend.title="Competing risk",
                  legend.legend=c("Kidney failure", "Death"), 
                  legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.9, lwd=2)
title("Cumulative Incidence curve:\nNo Multimorbidity")



# AJ for with risk groups - find cifs for KRT and death for each group
aj_risk <- prodlim(Hist(time, event) ~riskgrp, data = compr)
summary(aj_risk, times = 5, extend = T)

# Count of ESKD events
eskd_count <- sum(compr$event == 1)

# Count of Death events
death_count <- sum(compr$event == 2)

event_counts_by_riskgrp <- table(compr$riskgrp, compr$event)

compr_5yr <- compr[compr$time <= 5, ]

event_counts_by_riskgrp_5yr <- table(compr_5yr$riskgrp, compr_5yr$event)
```

```{r}
                    ylab="Observed risk of kidney failure or death", xlab="Time (years)", xlim = c(0, 5), ylim = c(0, 0.25),
                    legend.title="Competing risk",
                    legend.legend=c("Kidney failure", "Death"), 
                    legend.x="topleft",legend.cex=0.9, lwd=2)
title("Cumulative Incidence curve:\nMultimorbidity cohort")

CR_nomm_5_cut <- plot(aj_nomm, cause="stacked", confint=FALSE, percent=FALSE, atrisk=FALSE,
```

```{r Kaplan Meier vs Aalen-Johansen estimates by risk group split by age groups}
compr <- compr %>% 
  mutate(age_cat = cut(age, 
      breaks = c(18, 44.9, 64.9, 74.9,107), 
      include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(age_cat = fct_recode(age_cat,
      "18to44" = "[18,44.9]",
      "45to64" = "(44.9,64.9]",
      "65to74" = "(64.9,74.9]",
      "75plus" = "(74.9,107]"))


compr_1844 <- subset(compr, compr$age_cat == "18to44")
compr_4564 <- subset(compr, compr$age_cat == "45to64")
compr_6574 <- subset(compr, compr$age_cat == "65to74")
compr_75plus <- subset(compr, compr$age_cat == "75plus")


compr_mm_1844 <- subset(compr_1844, compr_1844$mmcount_nockd >1)
compr_nomm_1844 <- subset(compr_1844, compr_1844$mmcount_nockd<=1)

compr_mm_4564 <- subset(compr_4564, compr_4564$mmcount_nockd >1)
compr_nomm_4564 <- subset(compr_4564, compr_4564$mmcount_nockd<=1)

compr_mm_6574 <- subset(compr_6574, compr_6574$mmcount_nockd >1)
compr_nomm_6574 <- subset(compr_6574, compr_6574$mmcount_nockd<=1)

compr_mm_75plus <- subset(compr_75plus, compr_75plus$mmcount_nockd >1)
compr_nomm_75plus <- subset(compr_75plus, compr_75plus$mmcount_nockd<=1)
```

```{r Venn diagram}

# Load data
venn_scream <- readRDS("~/R working directory/SCREAM/venn_scream.rds")
  
venn_scream_short <- venn_scream %>% 
    select(lopnr, female, age, mmcount_nockd, cardio_mm, complexLTC, mixedLTC) %>% 
  mutate(LTC0=ifelse(mmcount_nockd==0,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(LTC1=ifelse(mmcount_nockd==1,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(LTC2=ifelse(mmcount_nockd==2,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(LTC3=ifelse(mmcount_nockd==3,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(LTC4=ifelse(mmcount_nockd==4,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(LTC5plus=ifelse(mmcount_nockd>=5,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(cardmet_complex=ifelse(cardio_mm==1&complexLTC==1,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(cardmet_mixed=ifelse(cardio_mm==1&mixedLTC==1,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(complex_mixed=ifelse(complexLTC==1&mixedLTC==1,1,0)) %>% 
  mutate(cardmet_complex_mixed=ifelse(cardio_mm==1&complexLTC==1&mixedLTC==1,1,0))

venn_scream_short <- venn_scream_short %>% 
  select(cardio_mm, complexLTC, mixedLTC, cardmet_complex, cardmet_mixed, complex_mixed, cardmet_complex_mixed)

counts <- venn_scream_short %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(. == 1)))

count_tibble <- counts %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "count") %>% 
  column_to_rownames("variable")




# Create Euler diagrams (in a list) using a loop-------------------

#get column list to loop over
var_names <- colnames(count_tibble) 


#loop over column (ltc) names
for (i in seq_along(var_names)[2:length(var_names)]){ #start from the 2nd column
  
  i <- 1
  
  #create name of plot object per ltc
  plot_name <- paste0("eulplot_", i-1)
  
  #for each ltc, get name to assign as plot title
  plot_title <- paste0(var_names[i], " (n=", sum(count_tibble[1:7,i]), ")")
  
  #loop feedback to console
  print(paste(plot_name, "is for", plot_title, sep = " "))
  
  #create data for each euler
        eul_dat <-
        euler(c(
          "Cardiometabolic" = count_tibble[[1, i]],
          "Complex" = count_tibble[[2, i]],
          "Mixed" = count_tibble[[3, i]],
          "Cardiometabolic&Complex" = count_tibble[[4, i]],
          "Cardiometabolic&Mixed" = count_tibble[[5, i]],
          "Complex&Mixed" = count_tibble[[6, i]],
          "Cardiometabolic&Complex&Mixed" = count_tibble[[7, i]]
        )
        )
  
        
  
  #plot the euler data per ltc
  eul_diag <- plot(eul_dat,
                   quantities = list(type = c("percent"), just = "centre", round=2, cex = 1.5), 
                   labels = F,
                   fills = list(fill = c("#440154FF","#1F9E89FF", "#35B779FF", "#482878FF","#26828EFF", "#3E4A89FF"), alpha = 0.5),
                   #main = textGrob(plot_title, just = "centre", gp=gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 12)) #hjust = 0, 
                   main = "Multimorbidity clusters in SCREAM",
                   legend = list(nrow = 6, ncol = 1)
  )
  eul_diag
  
  # Remove space and % sign from quantities
  # Substitute everything after space with nothing
  tags <- eul_diag$children$canvas.grob$children$diagram.grob.1$children$tags$children
  
  
  tags <- do.call(grid::gList, lapply(tags, function(x) {
    x$children[[2]]$label <- gsub(" ", "", x$children[[2]]$label)
    x$children[[2]]$just <- NULL
    x$children[[2]]$hjust <- 0.5
    x$children[[2]]$vjust <- 1
    x}))
  
  eul_diag$children$canvas.grob$children$diagram.grob.1$children$tags$children <- tags
  
  
  ggsave(paste0("~/R working directory/SCREAM/", plot_title, ".png"),
         eul_diag,
         width = 25,
         height = 15, #for 12 plots
         units = "cm",
         dpi = 600
  )
  
}
```
